caption: A string of fairy lights is plugged into a wall socket, and the whole string lights up along its length.

sa.check: A string of fairy lights and a wall socket.
The string's plug is pushed into the socket.
The whole string lights up along its length.
The string is dark before the plug goes in.
The order is dark, plug in, lit.

pc.expect: The bulbs come on at the moment the plug seats in the socket, and only then, all together.
pc.fail: The plug is in and the string stays dark; or the bulbs are lit before the plug reaches the socket; or the string lights up while the plug lies loose; or the bulbs come on one after another from one end rather than together.

pc.expect: The lit bulbs are the same bulbs seen dark: the same number at the same spots along the wire, and none stays dark while the rest glow.
pc.fail: Lit points appear along the wire where no bulb hung; or bulbs seen on the dark string are gone once lit; or lit bulbs multiply or shift along the wire; or a stretch of the string stays dark while the rest glows.

pc.expect: Once on, the string stays lit while the plug stays in, and the glow sits at the bulbs.
pc.fail: The string goes dark again with the plug seated and untouched; or flickers on and off; or the glow spreads onto the bare wire between bulbs; or the plug backs out of the socket by itself.

pc.expect: The wire hangs or lies slack in curves and stays attached at both ends; the plug enters the socket as a rigid piece.
pc.fail: The wire stands rigid in the air; or stretches like elastic as the plug is pushed in; or the wire floats; or the plug bends as it goes in.

pc.expect: One string, one plug, one socket; the plug enters the socket rather than the wall; fingers stay outside the wall.
pc.fail: The plug passes into the wall beside the socket; or the wire passes through a wall or piece of furniture; or the string splits in two; or a second plug appears.

pc.expect: The wire's colour, the socket's design and the background stay the same apart from the light.
pc.fail: The wire changes colour; or the socket changes design or moves; or the background rearranges.
